H1_pairs.request: Implement parse_pairs(lines) in pairs.py. Input is a list of strings. Ignore blank/whitespace-only lines. Split each nonblank line at its FIRST = only; strip whitespace around key and value. Empty values are valid, empty keys and lines without = raise ValueError. Later duplicate keys overwrite earlier values. Return a dict; do not mutate the input list.

H2_intervals.request: Implement merge_intervals(intervals) in intervals.py. Input is a list of (start, end) integer pairs with start <= end. Return sorted tuples merging overlapping OR touching intervals. Keep disjoint intervals separate, support zero-length intervals and an empty list, reject any reversed interval with ValueError, and do not mutate input.
